```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
rse_breast_gene <- recount3::create_rse_manual(
    project = "BREAST",
    project_home = "data_sources/gtex",
    organism = "human",
    annotation = "gencode_v26",
    type = "gene"
)
```
```{r}
counts_breast_gene <- assay(rse_breast_gene)

mlh1_counts_breast <- counts_breast_gene[
  rowData(rse_breast_gene)$gene_name == "MLH1",
]

lib_sizes_breast <- colSums(counts_breast_gene)

lib_sizes_breast_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(lib_sizes_breast),
  lib_size  = as.numeric(lib_sizes_breast)
)
mlh1_counts_breast_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(mlh1_counts_breast),
  raw_counts  = as.numeric(mlh1_counts_breast)
)
mlh1_breast_counts_df_merged <- merge(
  mlh1_counts_breast_df,
  lib_sizes_breast_df,
  by.x = "sample_id",
  by.y = "sample_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)
meta_breast <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_breast_gene))
meta_breast <- meta_breast[, c("external_id", "gtex.smtsd")]
mlh1_breast_counts <- merge(
  mlh1_breast_counts_df_merged,
  meta_breast,
  by.x = "sample_id",
  by.y = "external_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_counts <- mlh1_alltissues_counts %>%
  mutate(
    SAMPLE_ID = sample_id %>%
      sub("\\.\\d+$", "", .) %>%         # remove .1 / .2
      sub("-SM-.*$", "", .) %>%          # remove SM and everything after
      sub("^(GTEX-[^-]+-[^-]+(?:-[^-]+)?).*", "\\1", .)
  )
```
```{r}
replicates_mlh1_alltissues_counts <- mlh1_alltissues_counts %>%
  group_by(SAMPLE_ID, gtex.smtsd) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed <- mlh1_alltissues_counts %>%
  group_by(gtex.smtsd, SAMPLE_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    raw_counts = sum(raw_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    lib_size = sum(lib_size, na.rm = TRUE),
    sample_id = paste(sort(unique(sample_id)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# collapsing technical replicates with same SAMPLE_ID x gtex.smtsd combination
```
```{r}
replicates_mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed <- mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed %>%
  group_by(SAMPLE_ID, gtex.smtsd) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed <- mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed %>%
  mutate(
    donor_id = sub("^(GTEX-[^-]+).*", "\\1", sample_id)
  )
```

```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed <- mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed %>%
  group_by(donor_id, gtex.smtsd) %>%
  summarise(
    raw_counts = sum(raw_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    lib_size = sum(lib_size, na.rm = TRUE),
    sample_ids = paste(sort(unique(sample_id)), collapse = ","),
    SAMPLE_ID = paste(sort(unique(SAMPLE_ID)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# collapsing biological replicates from the same donor_id x gtex.smtsd combination
```
```{r}
replicates_mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed <- mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed %>%
  group_by(donor_id, gtex.smtsd) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_cpm <- mlh1_alltissues_counts_collapsed %>%
  mutate(
    mlh1_cpm = (raw_counts / lib_size) * 1e6,
    mlh1_log1p_cpm = log1p(mlh1_cpm)
  )
```

```{r}
table(mlh1_alltissues_cpm$gtex.smtsd)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(mlh1_alltissues_cpm, file = "mlh1_alltissues_cpm.rds")
```
```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_cpm <- readRDS("mlh1_alltissues_cpm.rds")
```


```{r}
mlh1_alltissues_cpm$gtex.smtsd <- as.factor(mlh1_alltissues_cpm$gtex.smtsd)
library(glmmTMB)

model_mlh1_expression_tmb <- glmmTMB(
  raw_counts ~ gtex.smtsd + (1 | donor_id) +
    offset(log(lib_size)),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = mlh1_alltissues_cpm
)

emm_mlh1_expression_tmb <- emmeans(model_mlh1_expression_tmb, pairwise ~ gtex.smtsd)

pairs_mlh1_expression_tmb <- as.data.frame(emm_mlh1_expression_tmb$contrasts)
pairs_mlh1_expression_tmb$fold_change <- exp(pairs_mlh1_expression_tmb$estimate)
```
```{r}
model_mlh1_expression_tmb
pairs_mlh1_expression_tmb
```
```{r}
emm_response_mlh1_expression <- emmeans(
  model_mlh1_expression_tmb,
  ~ gtex.smtsd,
  type = "response"
)

emm_response_mlh1_expression_df <- as.data.frame(emm_response_mlh1_expression)

ggplot(
  emm_response_mlh1_expression_df,
  aes(x = reorder(gtex.smtsd, response), y = response)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = asymp.LCL,
      ymax = asymp.UCL
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "MLH1 gene read counts"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb <- emmeans(
  model_mlh1_expression_tmb,
  pairwise ~ gtex.smtsd,
  type = "response"
)

# Convert contrasts to dataframe
pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df <- as.data.frame(pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb$contrasts)

# Keep only Breast comparisons
pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df <- pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df %>%
  filter(grepl("Breast / Mammary Tissue", contrast))

# Compute fold changes and percent differences
pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df <- pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df %>%
  mutate(

    percent_difference = (ratio - 1) * 100,

    lower_ci = ((ratio / exp(1.96 * SE)) - 1) * 100,
    upper_ci = ((ratio * exp(1.96 * SE)) - 1) * 100,

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    tissue = gsub(".*Breast / Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df <- pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df %>%
  mutate(
    contrast = gsub("\\s*/\\s*", " - ", contrast)
  )
# Plot
ggplot(
  pairs_response_mlh1_expression_tmb_df,
  aes(
    x = percent_difference,
    y = reorder(contrast, percent_difference)
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = lower_ci,
      xmax = upper_ci
    ),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference in MLH1 expression vs Breast",
    y = "Tissue comparisons"
  )
```

```{r}
library(lme4)

model_mlh1_expression <- lmer(
  mlh1_cpm ~ gtex.smtsd + (1 | donor_id),
  data = mlh1_alltissues_cpm
)
model_mlh1_expression_log <- lmer(
  mlh1_log1p_cpm ~ gtex.smtsd + (1 | donor_id),
  data = mlh1_alltissues_cpm
)
```

```{r}
plot(model_mlh1_expression_log, which = 1, main = "Log1p MLH1 CPM")
```
